use default

union Template is
    INDEX(position: int)
    GROUP(items: List[Template])
si

union Filled is
    PAYLOAD(text: string)
    GROUP(items: List[Filled])
si

at(position: int) -> Template => Template.INDEX(position)

group(items: List[Template]) -> Template => Template.GROUP(items)

fill(template: Template, payloads: List[string]) -> Filled =>
    case template
    when leaf: Template.INDEX then
        if leaf.position < payloads.count then
            Filled.PAYLOAD(payloads[leaf.position])
        else
            Filled.PAYLOAD("<no payload for {leaf.position}>")
        fi
    when nested: Template.GROUP then
        Filled.GROUP(
            nested.items |> map(item => fill(item, payloads)) |> collect())
    esac

render(filled: Filled) -> string =>
    case filled
    when leaf: Filled.PAYLOAD then "'{leaf.text}'"
    when nested: Filled.GROUP then
        "[{nested.items |> map(render) |> join(", ")}]"
    esac

positions(template: Template) -> Pipe[int] is
    case template
    when leaf: Template.INDEX then
        yield leaf.position
    when nested: Template.GROUP then
        for item in nested.items do
            yield in positions(item)
        od
    esac
si

    group([group([group([at(1), at(2)]),

si
